slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single image only; no backup/mirror found in code or bytes. FUN_080218bc (0x080218bc) returns 0=valid,1=bad magic,2=bad sum32 checksum; load path FUN_08021e98/FUN_08021e28 accepts only on EEPROM read success + FUN_080218bc result via FUN_080218bc(param,0), sets RAM+0x2080=1 on success. Write path re-stamps magic+checksum if invalid before flush.

checksums.name: sum32_le_image_checksum_FUN_080218bc
checksums.formula_detail: Static (FUN_080218bc): iVar5 = word0 + _DAT_08021b10 + word1 + word2; loop from word3 adding 4x u32 LE per iteration while iVar3=_DAT_08021b14 counts down by 4; compare to u32 LE stored at byte offset _DAT_08021b18; on write (param3!=0) and invalid, store computed sum LE at that offset and mark 4 bytes dirty via FUN_0800a648. Literal-pool values _DAT_08021b10/_14/_18 are NOT resolved in workspace (no ROM), so seed/addend, loop count and stored offset are unresolved. Python test on logical rev8 image: sum32(0..0x1ffb)=0xc4d220da vs candidate stored u32@logical 0x1ffc=0x7ee72cda (match=False); sum32 all=0x43b94db4; raw-file sum32 all=0x3965d698 vs raw u32@0x1ffc=0xffffffff (match=False); CRC32(0..0x1ffb) rev=0x85e3c8fd, raw=0xf874e6e0 (neither equals candidate). Therefore NOT verified on samples.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 driver: saves/restores DMA enable, sets DMA3SAD=param1, DMA3DAD=param2, DMA3CNT=param3&0xffff|0x80000000, polls CNT busy bit 0x8000 (0x040000D4 block per PACKET hardware spec). Used both RAM->0x0D000000 and 0x0D000000->RAM.

EEPROM read one 8-byte block: block addr param1 (< limit at EEPROM-descriptor+4), expands address bits (descriptor byte+8 bits, +3 with start bits 1,1) DMA to 0x0D000000, DMA back 0x44 halfwords, repacks 64 bits (uVar4<<1|bit) into 4x u16 at param2+6 descending - explains per-8-byte reversal between RAM logical image and raw .sav.

EEPROM write one 8-byte block: expands 4x u16 data + address bits into bit stack, DMA (addr_bits+0x43) to 0x0D000000, FUN_0804976c enables write latch/timer, polls uRam0d000000 bit0 / busy byte, FUN_080497f4 disables. Returns 0 on success.
Verify: FUN_080498b8 read-back into stack, compare 4x s16 to intended; return 0 match, 0x8000 mismatch.
Write+verify wrapper (called as func_0x08049a9c in FUN_0800a564, callgraph lists no callers - jumptable alias gap): up to 3 attempts of FUN_08049968 then FUN_08049a44, break on verify 0.
EEPROM write-enable/latch sequencing via descriptor registers (sets bit 8<<addr_bit_pos), copies param 3x u16 descriptor.
EEPROM write disable / cleanup counterpart to FUN_0804976c.
Bulk read: for block 0..(len>>3)-1 FUN_080498b8(block, buf); buf+=8. Called with len 0x2000.

Dirty-block flush: FUN_0800a414 finds first set bit in 0x80-byte bitmap at RAM struct+0x2000, func_0x08049a9c(block, block*8+image_base), FUN_0800a4bc advances to next set bit, clears bit, loops until byte index 0x80. Also FUN_080496cc(0x40)/FUN_08049734(2) configure EEPROM type first.
Magic (6B) + sum32 checksum validate; in write mode stamps magic, recomputes/stores checksum, marks bytes dirty via FUN_0800a648, recurses in read mode.

Dirty-bitmap setter: for each byte in [ptr,ptr+len) set bit 0x80>>(off>>3&7) in bitmap byte off>>6 relative to bitmap base (=RAM+0x2000) - i.e. 1 bit per image byte, 0x80 bytes bitmap per 0x2000 image (grouped per 8-byte EEPROM block by FUN_0800a414/4bc).
